title: Convoy: Core Loop
summary: Scout, load, move, unload, and repair vehicles before the next haul.

blocks.title: Repeatable Loop
blocks.body: Scout, stage, travel, respond to incidents, unload, and update the route with what you learned. The best convoy path gets safer each time.

blocks.title: Pressure Check
blocks.body: After each haul, check what slowed the convoy: fuel, cargo order, road hazards, escorts, or repair parts. Fix that before adding distance.

blocks.title: Stop Point
blocks.body: Park with fuel, parts, and a clear unload point. A stranded vehicle turns one bad decision into a rescue mission.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
